updates.rationale: The accepted result creates a credible converse program requiring modest direct effort to coordinate the code-induced constraints, posterior refinements, and certification strategy. Its structural necessity makes engagement highly likely, although a different converse route could supersede it.

The finite-block telescope and induced-law factorization are already supplied. Remaining work is technically substantial: establish a valid compactness or support reduction, impose jointly consistent binary-channel posterior constraints, control residual message dependence, and certify any resulting global converse optimization.

The exact entropic witness rules out broad universal-entropy and finite copy-lemma refinements but leaves channel-specific posterior inequalities, alternative single-letterizations, and direct multiletter code inequalities open. Exploratory work remains useful as a contingency rather than the primary route.
